Their preferred direction is to make the support demand something, through self-explanation or a Socratic dialogue tailored to the misconception.
Cohorts differ sharply: the Fall 2021 delayed gain was 1.02 points with a standard deviation of 8.39, against 5.31 points in Spring 2021.
The concentration is shown twice, as a rank correlation with the pretest and as a significant difference across pretest quartiles, for both behaviours.
Pre to post and pre to delayed gains are significant with large effect sizes overall, so the average benefit is not in doubt.
The behaviours may not be unproductive in every instance: high performers have been shown to use bottom-out hints as worked examples.
Neither indicator was validated against think-aloud, gaze or item-level evidence of what the student actually did with the hint.
The outcome is measured with the support absent, which is what makes this a statement about capability rather than about performance while helped.
The affordance is said to operate independently of pedagogical intent, so the mismatch is structural rather than a failure of instruction.
The relationships are correlational and from observational data, and the authors say they do not establish causation.
There is no unsupported comparison group, so the gains include ordinary instruction, maturation and test practice.
